name: LS-01 | Fun 003 | HubSpot Contact Sync
description:
# LS-01 | Fun 003 | HubSpot Contact Sync

**Ticket:** [Monday](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/12418264810)

## What it does
Pushes registrations not yet synced (hubspot_synced=false) to the HubSpot Form.

## Details
- **SELECT:** WHERE hubspot_synced = false AND email IS NOT NULL
- **Ruby transform:** builds fields + UTM:
  - last_utm_source = linkedin
  - last_utm_medium = social
  - last_utm_campaign = linkedin-event-[event-name]
  - linkedin_email_consent = TRUE/FALSE (string)
- **HubSpot Form:** 58253736-a4cb-4ae0-a440-79c914c2ddf2
  Portal: 7697697, endpoint: /submissions/v3/integration/secure/submit
- **After success:** hubspot_synced = true (batch update + status/error tracking)

## Pending Nizan's confirmation
- sf_sync value
- linkedin_email_consent — needs legal approval
- field mapping on the form

input.code:
event_name = input["event_name"].to_s

clean = ->(v) { (v.nil? || v.to_s.strip.empty?) ? nil : v }

# utm_campaign = linkedin-event-[event-name] (full, no truncation)
name_slug = event_name.downcase
  .gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "-")
  .gsub(/\A-+|-+\z/, "")
utm_campaign = "linkedin-event-#{name_slug}"

consent_val = input["consent"] ? "TRUE" : "FALSE"

{
  "firstname"                => clean.(input["first_name"]),
  "lastname"                 => clean.(input["last_name"]),
  "email"                    => clean.(input["email"]),
  "company"                  => clean.(input["company"]),
  "jobtitle"                 => clean.(input["job_title"]),
  "country_dropdown"         => clean.(input["country"]),
  "last_utm_campaign"        => utm_campaign,
  "last_utm_source"          => "linkedin",
  "last_utm_medium"          => "social",
  "linkedin_event_form_name" => event_name,
  "linkedin_email_consent"   => consent_val
}
